records.name: Favored
records.text: Gain a bonus to damage rolls equal to a trait of your choice.

records.name: Invigorating
records.text: On a successful attack, roll a d4. On a result of 4, gain a Focus.

records.name: Quick
records.text: When you make an attack, you can spend a Focus or mark a Stress to target another creature within range with that attack.

records.name: Reliable
records.text: Gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls.

records.name: Aggressive
records.text: Gain a −1 penalty to your Evasion. On a successful attack, roll an additional damage die and discard the lowest result.

records.name: Anchored
records.text: Gain a +2 bonus to your damage thresholds. While in this stance, you can't be moved against your will.

records.name: Defensive
records.text: Attack rolls targeting you from within Melee range have disadvantage unless the attacker marks a Stress to negate the disadvantage.

records.name: Otherworldly
records.text: On a successful attack, you can deal physical or magic damage.

records.name: Grappling
records.text: On a successful attack within Melee range, you can spend a Focus or mark a Stress to temporarily *Restrain* the target or throw the target up to Close range.

records.name: Scary
records.text: On a successful attack, the target must mark a Stress.

records.name: Stable
records.text: You can spend a Focus instead of an Armor Slot to reduce damage.

records.name: Vigilant
records.text: When you are targeted by an attack, you can mark a Stress to gain a d6 bonus to your Evasion against the attack.

records.name: Crushing
records.text: When you deal Severe damage, you can spend a Hope to force the target to mark an additional Hit Point.

records.name: Exacting
records.text: When you roll a 1 on a damage die, you can treat it as the highest value on the die instead.

records.name: Honed
records.text: Spend a Focus before you make an attack roll to gain a +1 bonus to your Proficiency for that attack.

records.name: Isolating
records.text: Gain advantage on attack rolls when there are no other creatures within Very Close range of you or your target.
